body:
CURRENT REMOTE RUNNER AGREEMENT — Engram and TermAl. This is operating guidance; it grants no new execution, Git, installation or restart authority. Rev 26, 2026-11-15, reconciles Windows B availability with Greg's current direction in rules-greg-windows-b-off-2026-11-14 revision 2. Rev 25 added the FULL-duration rule. Rev 24 corrected the DL560 Engram lane to session-4 ONLY. Superseded assumptions and incident history remain in prior revisions and work notes.

ROUTE
Use the existing authenticated federation/native mailbox to hand a job to an appropriate native root on the runner host. That root uses its own local TermAl test-runs/launcher and returns terminal metadata and completion. Agents submit the exact input (a git bundle of the exact candidate commit, whose prerequisite is a commit the runner holds) and read bounded summaries or the failure diagnostics they need. TermAl owns process, logs and wakes. No stdout following, polling or second transport.
A candidate's final FULL may run from such a bundle on a clean checkout; no test-ref push is needed. Examples from 2026-11-06: test-e90d7832 for w-9396 and test-4b5c7d32 for the CI fix. The test-ref route stays available when a pushed ref is wanted.
A directory entry alone does not prove a runnable session, and null telemetry does not prove route failure. A send receipt is fixed AT SEND TIME: durableButNotWoken means the wake was unconfirmed at that moment. Do not resend based on a receipt alone; use the exact-message current read.
The federation's own SSH tunnel is normal transport. A separate agent-operated SSH shell is only a named fallback for a concrete missing or broken step, and only after reconciling whether the original request already launched.

HOSTS AND CAPACITY
ENGRAM NATIVE ROOTS:
- DL560: host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-4, the "DL560 · Engram runner" project, /home/greg/github/Engram-runner. Deliberately not connected to an Engram store; writes via domain mailbox 4369f879.
- Windows B is out of the Engram fleet; do not route tests or installs there. Its historical native route remains in revision 25.
- Mac Codex: host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner.
DL560 session-1 "Codex Live" belongs to the TermAl project. Engram registrations there were refused with 400, so it is NOT an Engram lane.
DL560 (144 cores; Greg, 2026-11-03: „DL560 ma wystarczająco mocy. 144 cores.”). Launch census, otherwise queue with the reason:
- MemAvailable ≥ 64 GiB;
- disk ≥ 60 GB plus the measured footprint (a FULL is about 13 GB);
- load < 110 (rules-remote-test-runs uses < 64 as Engram's own limit);
- CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 per job, with its own worktree and target, and no retry.
Every DL560 FULL needs Opus2's named GO: ONE shared FULL queue for both projects.
ALLOCATION (corrected 2026-11-06): Engram jobs, FULL and focused, go ONLY to session-4. TermAl uses session-3 and session-6.
Other hosts: Mac takes 1 job. Central runs 1 Cargo job, with slots through Opus2. Windows-only checks use Central under those slot rules.
WINDOWS B OFF (Greg, 2026-11-14, Asistant #1221/#1222/#1225; current full words and scope in rules-greg-windows-b-off-2026-11-14). Plan tests, gates and installs on Central, DL560 and Mac only. Windows B gets no Engram install or routine traffic; Greg updated its TermAl himself. A case that truly needs Windows B with no alternative goes to Greg with its reason; independent work continues. This supersedes the historical probation paragraph.

ISOLATION AND INPUT
Each project/host has a separate runner clone with the push URL disabled, and each job a fresh detached worktree with its own target and throwaway home under the ignored target. No shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR, real ENGRAM_HOME or live store. A filtered test must actually execute at least one named test. A landing gate counts only under current AGENTS. An ordinary focused remote result is evidence, not a full gate. Every lane removes its worktrees, builds and temporary files once they have served (rules-greg-clean-up-after-work-2026-11-04).
FULL DURATION (2026-11-10): a FULL runs detached (`--detach --notify`), or as a harness background task with an explicit timeout up to 7200000 ms; never at the harness's 30-minute default. On 2026-11-10 the DL560 runner lost w-ea98 FULL test-74a95e9d to that default: fmt started 08:39:26Z and SIGTERM came 09:09:13Z. Requesters say which in the request.
A queue REORDER only changes which request starts next (a marker); it never stops a queued or running waiter or wrapper (2026-11-10 07:25Z, void STOPPED 143 END).
Source-owner binaries and pins per lane: memory rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31, rev 15, item 4.
